_doc: Draft content for design chapter 39. Assumes doc 37 C065-C067 are merged first. "add" entries use the content/practices.json fields at top level; "draft" holds the new fields of chapter 39 section 2 (era, category, hard = material preconditions for practice_hard, exclusive group, tension list, tradition) and name_zh for apps/web/scripts/i18n-data-practices.mjs. "T{...}" never remains: hard requirements name technology ids. lore "needed" for every new practice. New ids continue from C068; no new practice is a prerequisite of the victory-critical set; every exclusive group leaves a route to C064.
